name: Rating Stars
description: Interactive five star input built from reversed radios with a screen reader name on every star, plus a read-only display that fills fractionally by percentage. Entirely CSS, so both work with no JavaScript.
html:
Rate the Northwind integration
Tab to the group, then use the arrow keys to change your rating.
4.3 1,284 reviews

variants.name: With histogram
variants.description: The read only average gains a five row distribution beneath it, one bar per star band with the review count at the end of each row.
variants.guidance: Use on a product detail page or a review index, where the shape of the distribution is the honest part of the story: a 4.0 built from 575 fives and 54 ones is a different product from a 4.0 built from everyone agreeing. Do not use it in a listing row, where five bars cost more height than the whole tile. Bar widths are set with width utilities against the largest band rather than a token override, so the chart survives every skin without carrying a colour of its own.

variants.name: Inline count
variants.description: Stars, average and count collapse onto one line at extra small size, sized to sit under a product title in a listing row.
variants.guidance: Use inside a product row, a search result or a compact card, where the rating is supporting evidence rather than the subject. Do not use it as the rating block on a product page: at this size the difference between four stars and five is a few pixels. The average and the count share one muted line in tabular numerals so a column of these lines up down the page instead of jittering with each digit.
